Cedarline Health Partners (DEMO) is a labeled DEMO issuer (CDLH-DEMO); this is not a real SEC registrant.
Audit Committee concluded prior financial statements should no longer be relied upon (FY2024 Form 10-K and FY2025 interim periods).
Management disclosed a material weakness in ICFR: Controls over inventory existence, obsolescence triggers, and period-end reserve estimates.

sources.excerpt: DEMO FILING TEXT — not a real EDGAR document. On January 16, 2026, the Audit Committee of Cedarline Health Partners (DEMO ISSUER) concluded that the Company's audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2024, and the related audit report, should no longer be relied upon.

DEMO FILING TEXT. Certain specialty medical supplies approaching expiry were carried at cost. Subsequent physical counts and usage analyses indicated that net realizable value was below carrying value, understating cost of supplies and overstating inventory.

DEMO FILING TEXT. Management identified a material weakness in the design of controls over inventory existence and the operating effectiveness of controls that evaluate obsolescence triggers and period-end reserve estimates.

attacks: Do not treat DEMO excerpts as facts about any real registrant.
Compensating controls mentioned in filings are often detective-only and do not reduce a MW to a SD without evidence.
Management 'has not identified a restatement to date' is not evidence that the control is effective.
